svg.title: Vulkan built-in IDs on a dispatch grid
svg.desc: A three by two workgroup dispatch has workgroup size eight by four by one. gl_NumWorkGroups and gl_WorkGroupSize label those dimensions. The selected workgroup has gl_WorkGroupID (1,1,0), and the selected invocation has gl_GlobalInvocationID (11,6,0). A local grid expands this invocation at gl_LocalInvocationID (3,2,0). Nineteen preceding cells explain gl_LocalInvocationIndex 19. Coordinate conversion and a separately computed global linear index 155 are shown below. All Z coordinates are zero.
svg.text: 2 complete rows of 8, then 3 earlier cells in the current row
Computed by your shader, not a GLSL built-in. All Z coordinates are zero.
